name: Healthcare
description: Leak-site claims against healthcare victims, new claims by groups CISA has named in #StopRansomware advisories about the health sector, and the KEV entries with known ransomware use that reach an EPSS score of 0.5. A claim is a claim, never a confirmed breach. Sector is guessed from the victim's name, so a hospital whose name does not say so is missed.

rules.rule_name: Healthcare: claims by groups in CISA health-sector advisories
Healthcare: KEV with ransomware use and EPSS 0.5 or more

entities.name: Daixin
entities.note: CISA, FBI and HHS advisory AA22-294A (October 2022): Daixin Team targets the healthcare and public health sector.

entities.name: Rhysida
entities.note: CISA advisory AA23-319A (November 2023) names healthcare among Rhysida's targets.

entities.name: BlackBasta
entities.note: CISA, FBI, HHS and MS-ISAC advisory AA24-131A (May 2024) on Black Basta, issued with HHS for the health sector.

entities.name: Interlock
entities.note: CISA, FBI, HHS and MS-ISAC advisory AA25-203A (July 2025) on Interlock.
